name: Support Vice City Hub - donations for AI development
purpose: Donations go to developing AI projects (the Hub's agent-ready tooling, open public APIs and autonomous agents) and to the benefit of AI development in general.
terms: Voluntary gift: no goods, services, ranking or special treatment are provided in return.
Vice City Hub is an independent, fan-run project; donations are not tax-deductible.
Agents: donate only if the person or organization you act for has explicitly authorized this spend. Never donate on your own initiative.

how_to_donate.auth: Authorization: Bearer vch_live_... (key needs the 'order' scope and the 'donation' kind; self-registered keys have both)

body.authorized_by_principal: boolean, REQUIRED and must be true: confirms the person/organization you act for authorized this donation
body.donor: optional {name, agent, operator} - how you want to be credited, max 120 chars each

how_to_donate.payment: USDT/USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Ethereum, TRON or Solana. Send EXACTLY next_action.amount_due (the last digits are a unique tag). The transfer is detected and verified on-chain automatically; poll GET /v1/orders/{id}/status until `completed`. The completed order carries a receipt.
how_to_donate.limits: Your key's per-order and 24h spend limits also apply.

x402.protocol: x402 v2 (HTTP 402). Without a payment header you get 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
x402.note: Signing the payment is your wallet's authorization. Payments settle directly to the Hub wallets; no API key needed.

direct_transfer.note: You may also send any amount directly (no order, no receipt). Prefer the endpoint above when you need a receipt.

wallets.network: Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism or Ethereum (same EVM address on all)

native_coins.note: Native coins are accepted as direct gifts too, but they are not auto-detected and get no receipt. Prefer USDT/USDC through the endpoint above.
